create.doc: Create a new reminder for the current user. Stores a reminder task object linked to the authenticated user via the reminder_create stored procedure.

task.description: Reminder task data object containing the reminder details to store

returns.description: Created reminder record returned from the database

id.description: Unique identifier of the created reminder

get.doc: Get a specific reminder by ID, node ID, or hub ID. Retrieves a single reminder record matching the provided lookup criteria for the authenticated user.

nid.description: Node ID associated with the reminder

hub_id.description: Hub ID associated with the reminder

returns.description: Reminder record matching the lookup criteria

list.doc: List all reminders for the current user. Returns the full list of reminder records owned by the authenticated user via the reminder_list stored procedure.

returns.description: List of reminder records for the authenticated user

remove.doc: Remove a reminder by ID. Deletes the reminder record permanently via the reminder_remove stored procedure and returns the deleted record ID.

id.description: ID of the reminder to delete

returns.description: Confirmation of deletion with the removed reminder ID

update.doc: Update an existing reminder. Replaces the task data of an existing reminder identified by ID via the reminder_update stored procedure.

id.description: ID of the reminder to update

task.description: Updated reminder task data object to replace the existing task

returns.description: Updated reminder record returned from the database
